description: The supplied file is an HTML webpage implementing a self-contained, minimal quiz frontend with embedded CSS and JavaScript. It renders quiz questions, handles user interactions, timing, validation, grading, and displays results without external dependencies.

methods.name: pad2
methods.description: Pads a number with leading zeros to two digits for time formatting.

methods.name: formatElapsed
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to MM:SS format.

methods.name: updateTimerUi
methods.description: Updates the display of elapsed time.

methods.name: getTimerElapsedMs
methods.description: Returns the total elapsed timer duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Begins the timer interval for updating elapsed time.

methods.name: stopTimer
methods.description: Stops the timer interval and records the elapsed time.

methods.name: resetAndStartTimer
methods.description: Resets the timer to zero and starts timing anew.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Displays a message with optional styling (error or success).

methods.name: countAnswered
methods.description: Counts how many questions are answered from the answers map.

methods.name: updateProgressUi
methods.description: Updates the progress indicator showing answered questions over total.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes user input to prevent HTML injection in labels.

methods.name: shuffleCopy
methods.description: Returns a new array with items shuffled randomly.

methods.name: ensureQuizOrder
methods.description: Creates a randomized order of questions and options for display.

methods.name: renderQuiz
methods.description: Renders questions and options dynamically based on current order.

methods.name: getSelectedAnswers
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected answers from the form.

methods.name: computeScore
methods.description: Calculates the total score and records misses based on answers.

methods.name: renderResults
methods.description: Displays the final score, misses, and review instructions.

methods.name: clearUnansweredHighlights
methods.description: Removes visual highlights from unanswered questions.

methods.name: highlightUnansweredQuestions
methods.description: Adds visual cues to questions that are unanswered.

methods.name: validateAllAnswered
methods.description: Checks if all questions have been answered; returns validation result.

methods.name: clearGrading
methods.description: Removes grading markings and highlights.

methods.name: applyGrading
methods.description: Marks questions as correct or wrong based on answers.

methods.name: resetQuizUi
methods.description: Resets UI state and optionally re-randomizes questions.
